question: Whose unfolding is this process, and what is its inner nature?
premises: Because it is of supreme nature, the unfolding belongs to the first alone.
That same one is the Lord.
The Lord is inwardly always of a flashing-forth nature.
inference: The entire unfolding is the inner, ever-flashing manifestation of the supreme Lord.
plain_english: Because it is of supreme nature, this is the unfolding of the first alone. That very one is the Lord, inwardly always flashing forth.
